key_insight: Detonation-spraying parameters can tune titanium-dioxide-based coating roughness, thickness, and hydrophobicity, with optimal settings identified for maximum hydrophobicity.
engineering_relevance: The reported relationships can guide spray-process settings to achieve desired coating geometry and water repellency.
method: Vary nozzle traverse speed and spray distance during detonation spraying.
Evaluate coating roughness, thickness, and water contact angle.
Derive equations linking process parameters to surface characteristics.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports inverse-power relationships between traverse speed and roughness/thickness, and parabolic relationships between spray distance and roughness/contact angle.
watch_item: The abstract provides no numerical optima, parameter ranges, or model-fit metrics, limiting direct implementation without the full study.
paper_title: Surface Characteristics of Titanium Based Coatings Obtained by Detonation Spraying Under Various Process Conditions
